prompt_md: Among all families with exactly two children and at least one boy, what share have two boys? Each child is a boy or a girl with equal chance, independently.
prompt_short: Two-child families with at least one boy. Share with two boys?
hint_md: List the possible families in birth order.
explain_intuition_md: Two-child families come in four equally likely orders: boy-boy, boy-girl, girl-boy, girl-girl. Knowing there's at least one boy only rules out girl-girl. Of the three that are left, just one is boy-boy.
